views.markdown:
#### Version 1.3.0

- New: "Open in Filza" in the Local Files context menu, for files and folders (needs Filza installed).
- Fixed Safari's Downloads folder sometimes missing from Local Files Favorites: it is now looked up again if it wasn't found the first time.

#### Version 1.2.1

- Local Files: Safari's Downloads folder (On My iPhone > Downloads) is now in Favorites by default. You can still remove it from Favorites.

#### Version 1.2.0

- New: Share Button Find. Long-press the Share button in Safari's toolbar to open Find on Page (original idea by p2kdev's SafariFind). Turn it on or off in the new Toolbar section in settings.
- Now conflicts with SafariFind, since SafariPicker covers the same feature.

#### Version 1.1.0

- New "Source Code" button in settings.
- New settings icon.

#### Version 1.0.0

- Initial release, based on parts of SafariPlus by opa334.
- New Tab + Background: "Open in New Tab" and "Open in Background" side by side in the link menu.
- Private / Normal Mode: open a long-pressed link in the other browsing mode.
- Upload Any File: "Local Files" in the upload menu opens a read-only file browser with favorites, Go to Path, Copy Path, search, sorting and grouping.
- Reads /var/mobile and the jailbreak root by default; "Allow System File Access" (off by default, via libSandy) extends it to the whole file system.
